text_blocks.snippet: If you have COVID-19, you can expect a range of symptoms, similar to a cold or flu, but some may experience more severe illness. Common symptoms include fever or chills, a new, continuous cough, and a loss or change in sense of smell or taste. Other possible symptoms include shortness of breath, fatigue, body aches, headache, sore throat, runny nose, loss of appetite, diarrhea, and nausea or vomiting. Most people recover within a few weeks, but some may experience longer-lasting symptoms. Seek prompt medical attention if you have risk factors for severe illness or experience emergency warning signs like trouble breathing.
